dependency installation through execution and numerical acceptance for 22 representative problems. Scientific code, inputs and reference data come from the public-site distributions. Routine checks run eleven supplements and 40 supplementary cases with NumPy/SciPy/pytest. Independent-reference regeneration is a separate optional procedure. The common 22-case suite, including quantum-DFT convergence sweeps, remains manual on explicit need. Logs and JSON/CSV are retained in each run's Artifacts for 90 days. Downloading artifacts requires GitHub sign-in.
